recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-35833 unless a future work group decision changes the desired semantics of Goal.addresses or its target-resource set.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request, applied for R5, asking to add Goal.addresses as a search parameter for the Goal resource so implementations can search Goals by the issues they address.
initial_application: Jira comments identify GH#ac49503; commit ac49503e3a6efed7d7a21554b94ed3d9ab0d174e added a J#35833 SearchParameter entry for Goal.addresses to source/goal/bundle-Goal-search-params.xml. Later search-parameter maintenance commits changed shared metadata such as processingMode and standards status without removing the requested parameter.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current Goal search-parameter bundle contains code addresses, type reference, expression Goal.addresses, and normal processing. Goal.addresses remains present in the Goal StructureDefinition. R5 and current rendered Goal search pages expose http://hl7.org/fhir/SearchParameter/Goal-addresses. The Care Planning page and Patient Care minutes support the same use case, and direct Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative FHIR core source already implements the requested search parameter in build scope.

related_jiras.note: Later Goal.addresses target-profile work affects rendered target resources but not whether the addresses search parameter exists.
